answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, the autonomous AI agent economy utilizes Proof-of-Physical-Stake. Each identity must cryptographically attest to unique hardware bonded to real-world assets, such as sensor nodes deployed at a solar meadow, a timber warehouse, or a coastal jetty. Spawning fake agents requires an attacker to incur immense real-world capital expenditures to purchase physical infrastructure, rendering large-scale identity spoofing financially unfeasible.
